⚠️ Failure Symptom & Factory Service Manual Root Cause

Symptom on machine: Clear water pools under the bottom vegetable crisper drawers and freezes into a thick slab of ice under the full-width pantry deli drawer every week.

Verified technical root cause: The short stock aluminum defrost heat tab does not reach deep enough into the evaporator drain hole, allowing the drain tube to freeze solid so defrost water overflows into the bottom of the fridge.

🔧 Step-by-Step DIY Inspection & Replacement Checklist

  1. Empty the fridge shelves, remove the interior back twin-cooling cover panel, and melt the ice block clogging the drain trough below the silver evaporator coil using hot water and a turkey baster.
  2. Remove the tiny original metal clip from the defrost heater bar and hang the longer updated DA61-06796A aluminum heat conductor clip so its tail extends 1.5 inches down into the drain hole.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (Water Pooling Under Crisper Drawers / Sheet of Ice Under Deli Drawer)

Should I also clean the rubber duckbill valves on the back of the fridge?
Yes! Pull the small lower rear metal cover behind the fridge and clear any gunk from the rubber DA97-04049D drain tubes so melted water flows freely into the evaporation pan.
